Lawn Care & Maintenance

At Monroe Landscaping, we create our own lawn maintenance programs that are custom fit to your lawns specific needs. We offer Schedule Maintenance for your lawn which can include mowing, thatching, aerating, fertilizing, and much more.

Whether you would like us to do one of these services or all we have you covered!

Patios and Walkways, Fire Pits and Outdoor Kitchens, Retaining Walls and Custom Driveways are all types of ways to increase your properties appearance as well as enhance your living space.

This makes landscapes look beautiful 24/7, and allows you to enjoy your investment in your property.

Snow Storms are very unpredictable, that being said you need to be prepared for the worst!

We offer a full variety of snow plowing, removal, and de-icing services. We service a full range of residential and commercial properties. Services we provide are 24/7 snow plowing, snow removal off site, side walk clearing, and de-icing of parking lots and walkways. Call for reliable and affordable services!
